about_short_description.short_description: Adaptyv Biosystems developing a protein engineering platform using cell-free synthetic biology and nanofluidics.

product.name: Adaptyv Bio Protein Engineering Platform
product.description: A platform that automates experimental validation of AI-designed proteins by synthesizing, expressing, and assaying proteins to generate high-quality experimental data.

product.name: BenchBB (Bench-tested Binder Benchmark)
product.description: A curated benchmark dataset of seven protein targets designed to evaluate and validate protein binder design models through accessible lab testing.

product.name: Automancer Laboratory Automation Software
product.description: An open-source, modular software for designing and executing laboratory automation protocols compatible with various devices.

product.name: ProteinFlow Python Library
product.description: An open-source Python library for processing and preparing 3D protein structural data for deep learning applications.

product.name: Adaptyv Bio API
product.description: An API that enables autonomous protein design, experimental testing, and iterative improvement by integrating AI models with the wet lab platform.
